## What is PLU?

**Pokemon Level-Up!** is the ultimate RGX Mods creation for bringing that nostalgic Pokemon level-up feeling directly into your World of Warcraft experience. No more bland WoW level-up sounds — now you get the iconic chime that made every Pokemon level-up feel like a true victory!

### Why Choose PLU?
- **RGX Quality:** Built by the RealmGX community with passion
- **Multi-Language:** Supports every WoW client language: English, German, Spanish (EU/Latin American), French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) — enUS, deDE, esES, esMX, frFR, itIT, koKR, ptBR, ptPT, ruRU, zhCN, zhTW
- **Professional Standards:** Modern WoW addon architecture
- **Cross-Compatible:** Works across supported WoW versions
- **Active Support:** Join our Discord for instant help!

---

## Features

### Audio Experience
- **Pokemon Sound:** Authentic Pokemon-inspired level-up chime
- **Quality Options:** High, medium, or low quality variants
- **Volume Control:** Master channel integration
- **Smart Muting:** Auto-mute WoW's default sound

### Advanced Settings
- **Persistent Config:** Settings saved across sessions
- **Instant Commands:** Simplified slash command system
- **Error Handling:** Robust protection against crashes
- **Performance Optimized:** Efficient memory usage

### Multi-Language Support
- **English** (enUS — Default)
- **Deutsch** (German — deDE)
- **Español** (Spanish — esES, esMX)
- **Français** (French — frFR)
- **Italiano** (Italian — itIT)
- **한국어** (Korean — koKR)
- **Português** (Portuguese — ptBR, ptPT)
- **Русский** (Russian — ruRU)
- **简体中文** (Simplified Chinese — zhCN)
- **繁體中文** (Traditional Chinese — zhTW)

## WoW Compatibility
- **Midnight** (Retail)
- **Mists of Pandaria Classic**
- **Burning Crusade Classic**
- **Classic Era**

---

## Quick Start

1. **Install** Pokemon Level-Up! from your preferred platform
2. **Extract** to your WoW AddOns directory
3. **Restart** World of Warcraft
4. **Enable** PLU in your AddOns menu
5. **Type** `/plu help` to see all commands and start leveling!

---

## Command Reference

Use `/plu` followed by:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/plu help` | Show all available commands |
| `/plu test` | Play test sound |
| `/plu enable` | Enable addon |
| `/plu disable` | Disable addon (unmutes default sound) |
| `/plu welcome` | Toggle login welcome message |
| `/plu high` | Use high quality sound |
| `/plu med` | Use medium quality sound (default) |
| `/plu low` | Use low quality sound |

---

## Compatibility

| WoW Version | Interface | Status | TOC File |
|-------------|-----------|--------|----------|
| **Midnight (Retail)** | `120100` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp.toc` |
| **WoW Forever (Beta)** | `16001` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_Forever.toc` |
| **Mists of Pandaria Classic** | `50504` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_Mists.toc` |
| **Cataclysm Classic** | `40402` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_Cata.toc` |
| **Wrath of the Lich King Classic** | `38002` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_Wrath.toc` |
| **Burning Crusade Classic** | `20506` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_TBC.toc` |
| **Classic Era** | `11509` | Fully Supported | `PokemonLevelUp_Vanilla.toc` |

**Required Dependency:** [RGX-Framework](https://github.com/RGXMods/RGX-Framework) must be installed and enabled.

---

## Installation

1. **Download** from your preferred platform:
   - [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/pokemonlevelup) _(Recommended)_
   - [Wago.io](https://addons.wago.io/addons/pkmnlu)
   - [GitHub](https://github.com/RGXMods/PokemonLevelUp/releases)

2. **Extract** to your WoW AddOns directory:
   - **Retail**: `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns`
   - **Classic**: `World of Warcraft/_classic_/Interface/AddOns`
   - **Classic Era**: `World of Warcraft/_classic_era_/Interface/AddOns`

3. **Restart** WoW and enable PLU in AddOns menu

---

## What's New in v2.0.3

Click to see the latest updates!

### Major Updates
- **Multi-language support** — all 12 WoW client locales: enUS, deDE, esES, esMX, frFR, itIT, koKR, ptBR, ptPT, ruRU, zhCN, zhTW
- **Simplified command structure** — direct sound selection
- **Auto-unmute default sound** when disabling addon
- **Updated TOC files** for all WoW versions

### Improvements
- **Enhanced error handling** and stability
- **Better memory efficiency**
- **Consistent RGX Mods branding**
- **Updated documentation**

---

## Configuration Tips

### Default Settings:
```lua
enabled = true           -- Addon is active
soundVariant = "medium"  -- Medium quality sound
muteDefault = true       -- WoW's default sound is muted
showWelcome = true       -- Show welcome message on login
volume = "Master"        -- Volume channel
```

### Recommended Setup:
- **First Launch:** Try `/plu test` to verify sound is working
- **Quality:** Use `high` for the most authentic Pokemon experience
- **Volume:** If the sound is too loud, switch to `med` or `low`
- **Language:** The addon auto-detects your WoW client language (enUS, deDE, esES, esMX, frFR, itIT, koKR, ptBR, ptPT, ruRU, zhCN, zhTW) and falls back to English for anything else

---

## Known Issues

- No known issues at this time. Report any problems via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RGXMods/PokemonLevelUp/issues) or our [Discord](https://discord.gg/N7kdKAHVVF).

---

## Troubleshooting

**No sound playing?**
- Run `/plu test` to verify installation and sound playback
- Check that your in-game Master volume is not muted

**Wrong language?**
- The addon auto-detects your WoW client language (all 12 locales — enUS, deDE, esES, esMX, frFR, itIT, koKR, ptBR, ptPT, ruRU, zhCN, zhTW — are built in, anything else falls back to English). If incorrect, check your WoW language settings

**Settings not saving?**
- Ensure WoW has write permissions to its SavedVariables folder

**Still having trouble?**
- Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/N7kdKAHVVF) for instant support
- Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/RGXMods/PokemonLevelUp/issues)

---

## Contributing

## v3.0.7 - 2026-11-05

- Fixed WoW Forever: the base TOC now declares Interface 16001, which is what the Forever client reads, so the addon loads as compatible instead of out of date.
- Removed the unused _Forever.toc file.

# Non-beta Candidate: [v3.0.6](https://github.com/RGXMods/PokemonLevelUp/blob/master/changelogs/3.0.6.md)

Retail 12.1.5 / Interface `120105`; client testing and publication pending.

# v3.0.5 - 2026-09-27

# Non-beta Candidate: [v3.0.6](https://github.com/RGXMods/PokemonLevelUp/blob/master/changelogs/3.0.6.md)

# v3.0.5 - 2026-09-27

## Changes
- TOC set now covers every active WoW flavor: Retail 120100, Classic Era 11509, TBC 20506, Wrath 38002, Cataclysm 40402, Mists 50504, and WoW Forever 16001. The base TOC claims 120100,16001 so the Forever beta loads without the out-of-date flag.
- Added missing flavor TOCs: PokemonLevelUp_Cata.toc, PokemonLevelUp_Mists.toc, PokemonLevelUp_Forever.toc.
- Aligned the version (3.0.5) across all TOCs and ADDON_VERSION in data/core.lua.

# v3.0.3 - 2026-08-07

## Changes
- TOC bump: Updated universal interface versions to 11509 (Classic Era), 20506 (TBC Anniversary), 50504 (MoP Classic), 120007 (Retail). Removed Cata (40402) and legacy Retail eras (110207, 120000, 120001).

# v3.0.2 - 2026-06-30

## Changes

- Updated for WoW Retail 12.0.7 (Interface 120007).

# v3.0.0 - 2026-04-30

- **RGXSound handle**: Sound playback, variant management, mute/unmute, settings, and welcome message are now handled by the RGXSound module in RGX-Framework.
